title: Daily Creatine Supplementation
description: Daily intake of creatine monohydrate to support cognitive function, muscle performance, and overall energy metabolism.

actions.timing: Any time of day, ideally post-workout or with a meal
actions.details: Mix 5 grams of creatine monohydrate in water, juice, or your preferred beverage. Consistency is more important than timing. No loading phase is required for long-term benefits.
Drink at least 2–3 liters of water daily to support kidney function and optimize creatine utilization.

actions.action: Optional: Combine with carbohydrates for better uptake
actions.details: Consuming creatine with a source of carbs (like fruit juice) may increase uptake into muscles due to insulin-mediated transport.

benefits: Supports cognitive performance, memory, and learning
Improves strength, power, and muscle endurance
May reduce mental fatigue under stress or sleep deprivation
science: Creatine supplementation increases phosphocreatine stores in muscles and the brain, improving rapid ATP regeneration. Huberman Lab notes that daily creatine (3–5 g/day) can enhance memory, attention, and cognitive resilience, especially under sleep deprivation or stress. Muscle strength and recovery are also consistently improved.
contraindications: Individuals with kidney disease or impaired renal function should consult a physician
Avoid excessive dosages beyond recommended 5 grams/day
